title: Interleaved entropy coders
relevance: Primary reference for interleaved entropy coding. Shows how interleaving without additional metadata can be implemented for any entropy coder.

title: Entropy coding in Oodle Data: the big picture
relevance: Overview of Oodle's multi-stream entropy coding architecture. Explains the design rationale for multiple independent streams.

title: Parallelising Huffman decoding by synchronising non-self-synchronising prefix codes
relevance: Demonstrates that sync-point discovery enables virtual stream creation within standard DEFLATE blocks. Shows preliminary ~25% speedup with 2-way interleaving.
